scope: offline belief evidence replay protection and deterministic Rule IR binding validation
root_cause_hypotheses: MultiStepBelief treats the same evidence hash as independent evidence on every observation, so replay frequency can manufacture confidence.
Status-derived Rule IR slots treat status_code=0 after a transport error as an accepted HTTP response.
validate_binding authenticates the evidence envelope but does not recompute derived slot bindings, so a mutated binding value can remain valid.
interventions: Record duplicate evidence-hash observations but do not update the posterior more than once.
Keep response-derived slots unbound when transport_error is present or status_code is not positive.
Recompute expected slots from abstract Rule IR plus evidence during validate_binding and reject any mismatch.
failure_conditions: a duplicate evidence hash changes posterior state
a transport failure binds an authentication or authorization result
mutating a derived binding still validates
